package.name: litegrip_ros2_control
package.description:
The ros2_control adapter layer for the LiteGrip gripper: a C++ SystemInterface plugin + the shared memory contract + a Python hardware daemon that owns can0 exclusively (its peer is the LiteGrip gripper, over the STM32's gs_usb bridge).
Layered isomorphically to litearm_ros2_control: the C++ plugin side does only memcpy and the "opening (m) ⇄ motor angle (rad)" conversion, with no Python in the real-time loop; all hardware interaction, red-line checks, torque budget allocation and safe stops live in the daemon.
Interface surface (decided by the user on 2026-09-23): **command exposes position only** (matching the arm joints, MIT position control underneath); **state exposes position/velocity/effort** (matching the arm joints).
